scope: Immutable historical subset of reviewed curated graph identities and structural matched-pair relations, not potency or assay evidence. New curated graphs may be added without changing these historical identities or relations.
signatureDefinition: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify([core, [canonicalIsomericSmilesA, variableA], [canonicalIsomericSmilesB, variableB]]) with the two graph/variable tuples sorted by graph SMILES using JavaScript code-unit order; graph array indices and pair orientation are excluded.
